releases.name: 0.6.0 — annotate any session text
releases.body:
### Text review

- Add `/annotate-pick` to choose among recent replies and mid-turn progress updates, and
  `/annotate-selection` to review the message containing the last transcript selection.
- Move browser review to `/annotate-web` (pairing, URL, HTML file or `off`); `/annotate`
  now handles replies and documents only. Retire numbered `/annotate N`.

### Inherited TUI colors

- Add opt-in `inheritTheme` support for the color-capable Plannotator fork, including
  the OpenCode canvas, text, Markdown, borders, selection and cursor contrast pairs.
  Inherited colors also cover strong/emphasis text, list markers, rules, link labels,
  table headers and the send button.
- Validate a private per-review configuration before suspending the terminal; preserve
  the user's layout settings, including the fork's `doc_width`, and keep the themed
  config with recoverable drafts.

### Compact browser workspace

- Replace the always-expanded browser form with a selection-focused composer, numbered
  note queue, and persistent destination/delivery bar; keep controls visible at narrow widths and zoom.
- Autosave unfinished feedback by page, recover it after navigation or panel reload, and
  protect selection changes and competing-panel edits with explicit draft choices.
- Fix cancelling and reselecting the same element, add safe Show on page and revision-aware
  deletion Undo, and keep the intended destination visible while disconnected.
- Show pending/sent counts, distinguish original-batch retries from new feedback, and move
  copy/export/context utilities into More review options. **Save note** is now **Add note**.

## Install or update

```sh
opencode plugin update @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

New install: add `@nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest` to `plugins` in OpenCode's `cli.json`, then reopen the terminal client.

`inheritTheme` and `[ui].doc_width` need the extended Plannotator fork ([nxxxsooo/plannotator-tui](https://github.com/nxxxsooo/plannotator-tui), branch `feat/layout`); upstream 0.9.4 keeps working without them.

releases.name: v0.5.0 — new package name
releases.body:
OpenCode Annotate now publishes as **`@nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate`** from `nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate`. The old `opencode-plannotator-tui` package is deprecated. There are no behavior changes from 0.4.2.

### Switch from the old package
```sh
opencode plugin remove opencode-plannotator-tui@latest
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```
If you set `options.binary`, carry it over to the new entry in `cli.json`. Reopen the terminal client afterwards.

### New install
```sh
opencode plugin add @nxxxsooo/opencode-annotate@latest
```

releases.name: v0.4.2 — OpenCode Annotate
releases.body:
The project is now called **OpenCode Annotate**. It is still published as `opencode-plannotator-tui`, because the npm name `opencode-annotate` belongs to an unrelated package.

### Fixed
- `/annotate` on OpenCode 2.1.1: the terminal stayed blank and Plannotator TUI never opened, so Ctrl+C then quit the OpenCode client. The plugin now waits for the renderer to suspend and resume.

### Added
- Webpage review: `/annotate page.html`, `/annotate https://…`, `/annotate web` and `/annotate web off`, with an Annotate HTML-derived Chrome companion and exact-session Native Messaging delivery. Text review is unchanged.
- The browser companion shows live sessions automatically, preselects a sole target without sending, saves the current note on **Send & continue**, keeps drafts per URL, and filters private values and hidden text from exported context.

### Install or update
```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-plannotator-tui@latest     # new install
opencode plugin update opencode-plannotator-tui@latest  # existing install
```
Reopen the terminal client afterwards. Browser review is optional; see the README for the Chrome extension and native-host setup.

releases.name: v0.3.0 — Numbered reply selection
releases.body:
## Changes
- Use `/annotate 2`, `/annotate 3`, etc. to review older completed assistant replies.
- Bare `/annotate` and `/annotate 1` still select the latest reply.
- Missing replies and invalid numbers show a notice rather than selecting another source.
- `/annotate-last` now always selects the latest reply and ignores arguments.

## Migration
Replace `/annotate-last file.md` with `/annotate file.md`.

## Install / update
```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-plannotator-tui@latest
# Existing installations:
opencode plugin update opencode-plannotator-tui@latest
```
Reopen the terminal client after updating.

## Verification
21 behavior tests, package checks, real terminal/API smoke coverage, and npm Trusted Publishing passed.

releases.name: v0.2.2 — English interface text
releases.body:
## Changes

- Confirmation dialog, status notices, errors, and the feedback header sent to the assistant are now in English.

Published by GitHub Actions through npm Trusted Publishing with signed provenance.

```sh
opencode plugin update opencode-plannotator-tui@latest
```

Reopen the OpenCode terminal client to load the update.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/nxxxsooo/opencode-plannotator-tui/compare/v0.2.1...v0.2.2
